overview.text: ClawHunt presents an agent-product discovery directory with categories, featured listings, source-directory links and a security-watch section. Its interface displays totals, health labels and alert severity; these are directory assessments rather than independently reproduced monitoring or verified allegations about listed services. Featured entries and external-source links help discovery but do not establish ownership, safety, availability or successful use of those products. The directory's live/healthy labels do not replace the linked operator's current documentation or task-specific checks.
